notes.title: Kick Ass Commandos "America, F*CK YEAH!!!" Update (V1.0.6)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10537366/ebc99f4f6859210ab54151ea72fe8b8c227db864.jpg[/img]

What's new:

July 4th is a time to celebrate Independence, and there's no better way to do that besides lighting things on fire and detonating explosives! In celebration of this combustible summer holiday, there's a new playable character. George is the original Kick Ass Commando. He’s the reason ‘Muricans celebrate July 4th by blowing things up. Armed with a fully-automatic assault musket, he’s money and he knows it. Now get out there and shoot something - YEEEEEEE HAAAAAAWWWW!!

notes.title: Kick Ass Commandos "Valentine Bromance" Update (V1.0.5)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10537366/2c8bbbfbf25fa3967949459610dd1f4c20137ba0.png[/img]

What's new: 

Da Comrade! Love is in the air, and we're not just "Putin" you on - there's a new playable character! Vlad never met a man he didn't assassinate until he began his bromance with the Donald. When he’s not downing vodka shots with his fellow commandos, he poses shirtless - riding nuclear warheads into the sunset, singing "You down wit' KGB? Yeah you know me!"

notes.title: Kick Ass Commandos "Trumped-up Update" (V1.0.4)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10537366/0e0df6fccd254d943305f93930d9f4f780395dcb.jpg[/img]

What's new: 

A new President means a new "Kick-Ass-Commando-In-Chief"! The Donald is here to kick ass and tweet about it, and he's all out of tweets. Love him or hate him, he’s ready to pwn the enemy in 140 bullets or less. When The Donald pulls the trigger, the last thing they'll hear is "You're Fired!"
